items.briefing:
A critical vulnerability has been discovered in GitLab that puts software supply chains at serious risk. If your organisation uses GitLab to manage code or development projects, ensure it is updated immediately, as attackers could exploit this flaw to compromise systems upstream of your own. Separately, the Russian-linked hacking group Sandworm has been found chaining Cisco vulnerabilities together to deploy dangerous malware — organisations using Cisco networking equipment should verify patches are current.

On a privacy note, reports reveal that human reviewers may read ChatGPT conversations as part of AI training programs. Staff should avoid sharing sensitive, confidential, or client-related information in AI chat tools.

**Tip:** Treat AI chat tools like a public forum — never paste in private client details, passwords, or internal documents.
